finding_key: docs/design/documents-last-modified.md::new standalone top-level design doc instead of folding into the canonical backend doc, contrary to the repo's stated doc-filing policy
evidence: The policy quote is verbatim accurate: docs/design/README.md's "Obsolete docs" section says the durable design "lives in its canonical subsystem doc above, regardless of whether it shipped as a single PR. Fold a single-PR note into the relevant doc as a concise subsection rather than keeping it as a standalone file." The diff instead adds a standalone docs/design/documents-last-modified.md plus a Common-section README row, and never touches docs/design/backend.md, whose Document ER entry still lists only id/title/authorID/createdAt and whose API reference has no /internal/yorkie/events endpoint — so backend.md's schema/API description is left divergent. Two caveats reduce weight: the Common section already contains many arguably single-feature standalone docs (comments-mentions.md, rest-api.md, context-menu.md), so the convention is loosely enforced in practice, and backend.md was already stale before this PR (it omits Document.workspaceId/type and the workspace-scoped routes), so this PR only adds one more divergence rather than newly invalidating it. Documentation-organization only; no user-facing or correctness impact.
